fusions.name: Rolling Shove
fusions.desc: Shoulders the haft in and rolls forward, dealing 13 damage, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Unfurled Spin
fusions.desc: Spins the haft in a full circle, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Seams Closed
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Lapped Armour
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 14%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
